what_happened: Research prototyped the probe's load-bearing lemmas in lean_run_code against the library imports: the four stab truth lemmas on canonical histories (⊡Fp, ⊡Pp, ⊡¬Pp, ⊡¬Xp), the box-global transfer from Φ_true, and histOf_timeShift all compiled first try; cl Φ enumerated at 28 members, Xp ∈ cl Φ by decide.

rw [mem_cellAt_iff] and rw [canon_eq_x_iff] fail on goals mentioning cellAt M Φ (Node.pre k) z: the literal Node.pre k sits at type F.WorldState, defeq to Node only at default transparency, so kabstract reports the target not type-correct under implicit transparency. Workaround confirmed in the prototype: apply the iff lemmas in term mode ((mem_cellAt_iff M Φ _ z T).mp / .mpr, canon_eq_x_iff.mp) or ascribe the equation at type Node first; never rw them.

Plan phase re-derived the report's carried compile figure instead of trusting it: lake env lean on prototype/node-cell-stabilization-proto.lean exits 0 in 2.7 s with preCell_stable, preCell_zero_ne, postCell_stable (and xCell_stable) at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; only two unusedSimpArgs linter warnings (true_and, and_true). The plan is therefore a port, not a discovery.

Phase 1: the research prototype ported verbatim into the probe compiled first try under lake env lean (0 errors, 0 warnings after dropping the two unused simp args true_and/and_true; 346 lines; four #print axioms at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]). Neither named hazard (rw transparency, forall_eq simp set) fired because the term-mode .mp/.mpr and the verbatim simp call were kept.

Phase 1 commit: git-commit-phase.sh found no progress/phase-1-progress.json (lean agent writes none) and fell back to the fixed task-directory scope, so the staged probe file was left out of the phase commit; recovered with a follow-up git-commit-scoped.sh commit naming the probe path. Phases 2-3 will use git-commit-scoped.sh with explicit paths directly.
